t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They had the most success picking purple, brown and orange (and one other I can't remember - possibly yellow). They found the basket colour and S or K didn't really matter with the multiplier.

vb_textbox.text: I used the same theory throughout all the rounds. Purple vs pink are the biggest scorers, they swap back and fore between which scores highest but both are good. Yellow is mostly higher than green. Brown is usually higher than red. Orange is usually higher than blue. But they do swap around so sometimes it's just trial and error. The colour of the baskets and which way round the colours were (s and k) didn't seem to make any difference.
